spotlights.summary: High Masters to Champion 5 in 3 weeks.
spotlights.focusAreas:
Game sense
Aim mechanics
Hitscan hero pool
spotlights.notes:
![Beleo's streak to hit Champion.](/assets/uploads/wins.png "Beleo's Winstreak")

![Beleo hitting Champ 5 on July 27th, 3 weeks after the beginning of the program.](/assets/uploads/screenshot-2026-07-28-083504.png "Beleo Hitting Champ")

Beleo worked closely with coaches EOO/Trip and psev to hit Champ 5 in only 3 weeks. 2-3 vods a week and with effort put in from Beleo, he was able to quickly climb to Champ 5. 

We worked not only on his gamesense, incorporating good range drills, power positions, and teaching him how to monitor resources, but also his aim, more specifically micro corrections and general control tracking to improve smoothness and corrections.

Beleo also transitioned from a Soldier one trick to a full fledged hitscan in the given timeframe. Working closely with EOO/Trip, he improved not only on Soldier, but on Cassidy, Widowmaker, and Sojourn.

Give him a follow, [here on twitter](https://x.com/beleofps).
